title: The Faithful Regiment
author: U. M. Sterling
blurb: Edmund Okonkwo, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
